metadata.name: Bunker Cross
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: Crossfire remade: two concrete bases glare at each other across a sunken courtyard. Snipe from the roof nests and galleries, fight over the rocket launcher on the bridge and the railgun in the shelter under it, run the tunnels and vents, and when the courtyard fills up, hit the air strike in strike control: a siren, a ten-second countdown, the shelter doors seal and the bombardment rolls across everything outside.

do.text: Strike control, off the north side hall, can call an air strike on the courtyard. The shelter is under the bridge.
AIR STRIKE INBOUND! Get indoors or down into the shelter!
Air strike control is ready again.
All clear. The shelter doors are open.
